faqs.a:
Before a regular employee is suspended without pay, demoted, or dismissed, the employee's
               appointing authority shall provide the employee with a written statement describing
               the reason(s) for such proposed action. Prior to the effective date of such proposed
               action, the appointing authority shall provide the employee with an opportunity to
               be heard and to respond to the reason(s) for such proposed action.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
